mapper.sql:
(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(d.value ORDER BY d.first_pos), '[]'::jsonb) FROM ( SELECT target.value, min(source.pos * 101 + target.pos) first_pos FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(
) WITH ORDINALITY source(value, pos) CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(CAST(#{mapping} AS jsonb) -> source.value) WITH ORDINALITY target(value, pos) GROUP BY target.value ) d)
